retention.notes: the 25 GB and 25/25 RCU-WCU figures are the always-free allowance, not a 12-month one, which is what makes the row usable without a countdown

egress.terms: transfer out is billed; the free tier does not include a transfer allowance for DynamoDB

tooling: boto3, the AWS CLI, any DynamoDB SDK
chaining: 25 GB that never expires and never pauses, behind an AWS account that needs a card

25 GB storage per region; 400 KB per item

limits_note: 2.5 million Streams read requests a month are also included
